# bioexcel/biobb_io/mddb

## Summary

This class is a wrapper for downloading a trajectory / topology pair from the MDDB Database.

Wrapper for the MDDB Database for downloading a trajectory and its corresponding topology.

Nextflow adapter of the [MDDB](https://biobb-io.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html#module-api.mddb) building block of [biobb_io](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_io) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_IO_MDDB } from 'bioexcel/biobb_io/mddb'

workflow {
    BIOBB_IO_MDDB(channel.of([id: 'sample']))
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_top_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output toplogy file |
| `output_trj_path` | yes | mdcrd, trr, xtc | Path to the output trajectory file |
| `versions_biobb_io` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_io', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of MDDB properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_top_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_io container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_IO_MDDB' {
        ext.properties = [trj_format: 'mdcrd']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | null | Project accession or identifier. |
| `node_id` | string | "mmb" | MDDB node identifier. |
| `trj_format` | string | "xtc" | Trajectory format. Values: mdcrd, trr, xtc. |
| `frames` | string | null | Specify a frame range for the returned trajectory. Ranges are defined by dashes, and multiple ranges can be defined separated by commas. It can also be defined as the start:end:step format (ie: '10:20:2'). |
| `selection` | string | null | Specify a NGL-formatted selection for the returned trajectory. See here for the kind of selection that can be used: http://nglviewer.org/ngl/api/manual/usage/selection-language.html. |
| `extra_files` | array | null | List of extra files to download. It should be a tuple with the name of the file and the path to be saved. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
